```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(crosstalk)
library(htmlwidgets)
```
::: {.column-screen style="padding: 0 20px;"}
```{r}
# 2. Data Loading
data_path <- "../data/survey_data.csv"

if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  stop(paste("File not found at:", data_path, "\nPlease check your directory path."))
}

# Load the CSV
data <- read_csv(data_path)

# =========================================================================
# 2.b Dynamic Image URL Construction (For GCloud / Standard Web Hosting)
# =========================================================================
# Toggle this to TRUE when you move to Google Cloud Storage. 
# While FALSE, the map will continue to use the Img1-Img4 columns in your CSV (for your GDrive test).
use_gcloud_paths <- TRUE

if (use_gcloud_paths) {
  # Replace with your actual public Google Cloud Storage bucket URL
  gcs_bucket_url <- "https://storage.googleapis.com/ncrmp-photos-test"
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      # 1. Map Region to shortened abbreviation for directory paths
      CleanRegion = case_when(
        Region == "St. Thomas/John" ~ "STTSTJ",
        Region == "St. Croix" ~ "STX",
        Region == "Puerto Rico" ~ "PRICO",
        TRUE ~ gsub("/", "_", Region) # Fallback just in case there are others
      ),
      
      # 2. Build predictable paths: Bucket / Year / Region / SurveyID / 1.jpg
      # If a site only has 2 images, 3.jpg will 404, but our HTML 'onerror' tag will hide it cleanly!
      Img1 = paste0(gcs_bucket_url, "/", Year, "/", CleanRegion, "/", SurveyID, "/1.jpg"),
      Img2 = paste0(gcs_bucket_url, "/", Year, "/", CleanRegion, "/", SurveyID, "/2.jpg"),
      Img3 = paste0(gcs_bucket_url, "/", Year, "/", CleanRegion, "/", SurveyID, "/3.jpg"),
      Img4 = paste0(gcs_bucket_url, "/", Year, "/", CleanRegion, "/", SurveyID, "/4.jpg")
    )
} else {
  # Failsafe: Ensure image columns exist for the GDrive PoC if missing
  for (col in c("Img1", "Img2", "Img3", "Img4")) {
    if (!col %in% names(data)) {
      data[[col]] <- NA
    }
  }
}
# =========================================================================


# 3. Create Shared Data Object (Crosstalk)
shared_data <- SharedData$new(data)

# 4. Create the Map
map <- leaflet(shared_data, width = "100%", height = "60vh") %>%
  addTiles(group = "Street Map") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~Lon, 
    lat = ~Lat,
    radius = 5,                 
    color = "#0073FF",          
    stroke = FALSE,             
    fillOpacity = 0.7,          
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<div style='font-family: sans-serif; min-width: 200px;'>",
      "<b>Survey ID:</b> ", SurveyID, "<br>",
      "<b>Region:</b> ", Region, "<br>",
      "<b>Year:</b> ", Year,
      "</div>",
      
      # Hide the images within the popup so our Javascript listener can grab them 
      "<div class='hidden-images' style='display: none;'>",
      "<div style='display: flex; gap: 15px; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between;'>",
      
      # We added 'flex: 1' to the <a> tags to make them stretch equally, 
      # and 'height: 250px' to the images to prevent them from collapsing.
      ifelse(!is.na(Img1), paste0("<a href='", Img1, "' target='_blank' style='flex: 1; min-width: 0;'><img src='", Img1, "' style='width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid #dee2e6;' onerror=\"this.style.display='none';\" /></a>"), ""),
      ifelse(!is.na(Img2), paste0("<a href='", Img2, "' target='_blank' style='flex: 1; min-width: 0;'><img src='", Img2, "' style='width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid #dee2e6;' onerror=\"this.style.display='none';\" /></a>"), ""),
      ifelse(!is.na(Img3), paste0("<a href='", Img3, "' target='_blank' style='flex: 1; min-width: 0;'><img src='", Img3, "' style='width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid #dee2e6;' onerror=\"this.style.display='none';\" /></a>"), ""),
      ifelse(!is.na(Img4), paste0("<a href='", Img4, "' target='_blank' style='flex: 1; min-width: 0;'><img src='", Img4, "' style='width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid #dee2e6;' onerror=\"this.style.display='none';\" /></a>"), ""),
      
      "</div></div>"
    ),
    group = "Surveys"
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Street Map", "Satellite"),
    overlayGroups = c("Surveys"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      this.on('popupopen', function(e) {
        var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
        tempDiv.innerHTML = e.popup.getContent();
        var hiddenImages = tempDiv.querySelector('.hidden-images');
        var panel = document.getElementById('photo-panel');
        if (hiddenImages && panel) {
          panel.innerHTML = hiddenImages.innerHTML;
          // Change the background style of the panel once photos are loaded
          panel.style.border = 'none';
          panel.style.background = 'transparent';
          panel.style.padding = '0'; // Remove padding so images stretch edge-to-edge
        }
      });
    }
  ")

# 5. Assemble the Dashboard with Filters
# We move the photo panel inside the R chunk and group it with the map using tagList
photo_panel <- htmltools::HTML('
  <div id="photo-panel" style="margin-top: 15px; padding: 10px; background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 250px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #6c757d; font-family: sans-serif; border: 2px dashed #ccc; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;">
    <h3 style="margin: 0;">Select a survey point on the map to view photos</h3>
  </div>
')

dashboard <- bscols(
  widths = c(2, 10), 
  list(
    filter_select(id = "region_filter", label = "Select Region:", sharedData = shared_data, group = ~Region),
    filter_checkbox(id = "year_filter", label = "Select Year(s):", sharedData = shared_data, group = ~Year, inline = FALSE)
  ),
  htmltools::tagList(
    map,
    photo_panel
  )
)

# 6. Display the Dashboard
dashboard
```
